name: workplatform
description: 基于 pnpm workspace 的 TypeScript 多包项目

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/boot/app-boot/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/plugin-market/tsconfig.build.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/boot/app-boot/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/plugin-market/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/elect/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/boot/app-boot/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/plugin-market/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p apps/elect/tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm run build
